transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hi, Dr. Smith. I came in because... well, I keep hearing people talking about me. It usually happens through the conference room walls, or even from my phone when it’s completely turned off. It's the board members, mostly, or my staff, saying that I’m ruining the company. It sounds so clear that I actually answer them out loud before I realize that no one else heard anything.
Have you experienced any periods where your mood felt significantly lower or higher than usual, lasting for at least a few days at a time?

No, not really. I mean... my mood feels pretty normal, mostly. I don't have days where I feel completely down or, you know, unusually high or energetic. I get stressed, obviously, because of what I'm hearing them say about me, but my actual mood hasn't been swinging around or anything like that.

Aside from hearing these voices, have you noticed any changes in your ability to take care of your daily responsibilities, such as keeping up with personal hygiene or maintaining your typical routine?

Yes, I have. Work has gotten... well, I'm no longer reliably able to run my division. I just can't seem to keep up with basic executive decisions anymore, and my senior staff have quietly taken over the work I used to handle myself. And at home, it's similar. My husband has had to manage most of the household responsibilities now. I just... I either leave things unfinished, or I don't even start them at all.
Have you ever been diagnosed with any significant medical conditions, or have you had any recent head injuries or neurological issues?
No, nothing like that. I haven't had any head injuries or... any neurological problems. I don't have any major medical conditions, either. Physically, I'm completely fine.
How long have you been experiencing these voices and the difficulty with your daily responsibilities?

It's been building up for a while now. I'd say... about two years and four months. That was right around the time the company had an expansion, and they put me in charge of the new arts-and-commerce division. That's really when all of this started.
